costs.intro: A BMW X4 xDrive28i engine rebuild starts from
costs.body: A BMW X4 xDrive20i/xDrive28i engine rebuild starts from £2,200, whether your car has the N20 or the B48. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.
